sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球排名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州及全球各地合作创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学促进所有生物生活质量使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 请登录 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: You probably all heard the This American Life episode called When Patents Attack, about innovation stifling tech industry patents and patent trolls.
sentences.zh: 你们可能都听过《This American Life》的一期节目，叫做《当专利袭来》，讲的是压制创新的科技行业专利和专利流氓。

sentences.en: Oh, it's so good.
sentences.zh: 噢，太精彩了。

sentences.en: It's so good.
sentences.zh: 真的太精彩了。

sentences.en: If you haven't heard it, you should just go listen to it right now.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没听过，现在就应该去听听。

sentences.en: Oh, wait.
sentences.zh: 哦，等等。

sentences.en: Now, you don't really have to have heard the TAL show, but it gives an interesting backdrop to what you're about to hear.
sentences.zh: 其实，你不用非得听过这档节目，但它为你即将听到内容提供了一个有趣的背景。

sentences.en: Because as horrible and egregious as patent enforcement and lawsuits are today, they rarely result in murder.
sentences.zh: 因为尽管当今的专利执行和诉讼是如此可怕和过分，但它们很少导致谋杀。

sentences.en: Murder, sir?
sentences.zh: 谋杀，先生？

sentences.en: But things were different in 1879.
sentences.zh: 但在1879年，情况就不同了。

sentences.en: That's when a hounded and pursued patent violator struck back and made it possible for average working people to afford quality dentures.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，一个饱受追捕和困扰的专利侵权者进行反击，让普通劳动阶层也能买得起优质假牙。

sentences.en: It's a very historically significant murder.
sentences.zh: 这是一场具有重大历史意义的谋杀案。

sentences.en: I mean, anyone who ever gets dentures is indirectly affected by this crime.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，任何装过假牙的人都间接受到了这起犯罪的影响。

sentences.en: That's John Marr.
sentences.zh: 那是约翰·马尔。

sentences.en: My name's John Marr.
sentences.zh: 我叫约翰·马尔。

sentences.en: I'm the editor and publisher of the fanzine Murder Can Be Fun.
sentences.zh: 我是地下刊物《谋杀可以很有趣》的编辑兼出版人。

sentences.en: Before the 1850s, dentures were made out of very hard, very painful, and very expensive material like gold or ivory.
sentences.zh: 在19世纪50年代之前，假牙是用非常坚硬、非常痛苦且非常昂贵的材料制成的，比如黄金或象牙。

sentences.en: They were a luxury item.
sentences.zh: 它们是奢侈品。

sentences.en: But the invention of vulcanite hard rubber changed everything.
sentences.zh: 但硬质硫化橡胶的发明改变了一切。

sentences.en: It was moldable, it could be precisely fitted, and it was relatively cheap.
sentences.zh: 它具有可塑性，可以精准贴合，而且相对便宜。

sentences.en: Everyone began making dentures with vulcanite.
sentences.zh: 每个人开始用硫化橡胶制作假牙。

sentences.en: And these dentures had been overwhelmingly popular.
sentences.zh: 而这些假牙大受欢迎。

sentences.en: But then in 1864, a long-disputed patent application, originally filed a dozen years earlier in 1852, was awarded and then acquired by the Goodyear Dental Vulcanite Company.
sentences.zh: 但到了1864年，一项长期存在争议的专利申请——最初是在十几年前的1852年提交的——终于获批，随后被固特异牙科硫化橡胶公司收购。

sentences.en: It was a company created to collect fees or, very often, sue dentists who already used vulcanite.
sentences.zh: 这是一家专门为了收取费用，或者往往是起诉已经在使用硫化橡胶的牙医而成立的公司。

sentences.en: And there were plenty of dentists to go after.
sentences.zh: 有大量的牙医可以成为他们的目标。

sentences.en: And the person that went after them was named Josiah Bacon, the treasurer of the Goodyear Dental Vulcanite Company.
sentences.zh: 而追捕他们的人名叫约西亚·培根，他是固特异牙科硫化橡胶公司的财务主管。

sentences.en: And the Vulcanite Company was trying to collect, and Josiah Bacon was trying to personally collect, royalties from their patent from the dentists.
sentences.zh: 硫化橡胶公司试图收取专利费，约西亚·培根也试图亲自向牙医收取专利费。

sentences.en: The Goodyear Vulcanite Company now monopolized the market.
sentences.zh: 固特异硫化橡胶公司现在垄断了市场。

sentences.en: Dentists were required to buy their rubber and other contraptions used to make denture bases from them.
sentences.zh: 牙医被要求从他们那里购买制作假牙基托所用的橡胶和其他装置。

sentences.en: And there were heavy taxes and fees associated with all of this.
sentences.zh: 这背后伴随着沉重的税收和费用。

sentences.en: The price just kept going up and up.
sentences.zh: 价格一路飙升。

sentences.en: Josiah Bacon was crisscrossing the country, throwing dentists in jail, extracting fees, fines, setting up sting operations.
sentences.zh: 约西亚·培根穿梭于全国各地，把牙医送进监狱、勒索费用、罚款、设置钓鱼执法。

sentences.en: He was a very busy man, very enthusiastic about enforcing his patent.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常忙碌的人，对执行专利充满热情。

sentences.en: It was reported, and disputed, that Bacon's zeal for enforcing the patent may have been more his personal mission than that of the Goodyear Vulcanite Company.
sentences.zh: 据报道（不过也有争议），培根对执行专利的狂热可能更多是他个人的使命，而非固特异硫化橡胶公司的整体政策。

sentences.en: He had rigged the deal, so he actually personally got the money.
sentences.zh: 他设计了这笔交易，所以他实际上能亲手拿到钱。

sentences.en: I don't know how much the details, but it sounds like a very unusual financial arrangement with the company.
sentences.zh: 我不知道具体细节，但听起来这是一笔与公司非常寻常的财务安排。

sentences.en: Enter Samuel Chalfant, a dentist who made dentures and who didn't pay the Goodyear Vulcanite Company for the privilege.
sentences.zh: 出场的是塞缪尔·查尔方特，一名制作假牙的牙医，他没有为这份特权向固特异硫化橡胶公司付费。

sentences.en: And Josiah Bacon was out to make an example of him.
sentences.zh: 而约西亚·培根誓要拿他杀鸡儆猴。

sentences.en: Josiah Bacon had chased Chalfant out of Delaware, out of St. Louis, and finally in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 约西亚·培根把查尔方特一路从特拉华赶到圣路易斯，最后赶到了旧金山。

sentences.en: And he was swearing he was going to send him to prison.
sentences.zh: 并且他发誓要将他送进监狱。

sentences.en: Samuel Chalfant was completely beaten down by this relentless pursuit and claimed that he went to Josiah Bacon's San Francisco hotel room on Easter Sunday, 1879,
sentences.zh: 塞缪尔·查尔方特被这种无休止的追捕折磨得筋疲力尽，据称他在1879年的复活节星期天来到了约西亚·培根在旧金山的酒店房间，

sentences.en: to make peace, to pay whatever he could, and just go back to being a simple dentiSt.
sentences.zh: 为了求和，支付他所能支付的一切，然后回去重新做一个简单的牙医。

sentences.en: However, Chalfant, he had a gun in his pocket.
sentences.zh: 然而，查尔方特的口袋里揣着一把枪。

sentences.en: And as he says, he argued with Bacon.
sentences.zh: 正如他所说，他与培根发生了争执。

sentences.en: Bacon threatened to send him to prison.
sentences.zh: 培根威胁要把他送进监狱。

sentences.en: To command some respect, Chalfant pulled the gun, and as guns that you wave in front of your enemies always do, it went off.
sentences.zh: 为了树立一点尊严，查尔方特掏出了枪，正如你在敌人面前挥舞枪支时常有的那样，枪走火了。

sentences.en: Samuel Chalfant murdered Josiah Bacon.
sentences.zh: 塞缪尔·查尔方特谋杀了约西亚·培根。

sentences.en: Chalfant was, like, extremely upset.
sentences.zh: 查尔方特当时极其心烦意乱。

sentences.en: He sat in the hotel suite, waiting for people to come in to capture him.
sentences.zh: 他坐在酒店套房里，等待人们进来抓他。

sentences.en: Everyone was down at breakfast, so he slipped out of the hotel.
sentences.zh: 当时大家都下楼吃早餐了，于是他悄悄溜出了酒店。

sentences.en: And he wandered around the city and took a room in a cheap rooming house and just kind of laid in bed for a couple days, you know, guilty, feverish, distraught.
sentences.zh: 他在城里四处游荡，在一家廉价旅馆租了个房间，在床上躺了两天，你知道的，充满了负罪感、发烧、心烦意乱。

sentences.en: And then he turned himself in at the police.
sentences.zh: 然后他向警方自首了。

sentences.en: He made a statement to the police where he said that he had shot Bacon accidentally.
sentences.zh: 他向警方做了陈述，说他是意外枪击了培根。

sentences.en: And the police believed he was sincere, thinking that he'd have to come up with some story better than that if it was truly premeditated.
sentences.zh: 警方认为他是真诚的，因为如果是蓄意谋杀，他肯定会编造一个比这更好的故事。

sentences.en: However, when it came time for a trial, the prosecution had this man marching in the hotel room of his bitterest enemy with a loaded gun in his pocket.
sentences.zh: 然而，到了审判的时候，控方指出此人揣着上膛的枪走进了死敌的酒店房间。

sentences.en: The consensus was he was very lucky to get off with a 10-year sentence for second-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 普遍的共识是，他因二级谋杀罪而被判处10年徒刑，真的是非常幸运。

sentences.en: He actually had a very good gig in prison.
sentences.zh: 他在监狱里其实过得很不错。

sentences.en: He was the prison dentiSt.
sentences.zh: 他是监狱的牙医。

sentences.en: He had an office outside the walls.
sentences.zh: 他在高墙外面有一间办公室。

sentences.en: Or actually, most importantly, he didn't have to work in the jute mill making burlap sacks like most of the other poor guys did.
sentences.zh: 或者更重要的是，他不必像其他大部分可怜人那样去黄麻厂织麻袋。

sentences.en: The only part of the prison uniform he had to wear were striped trousers.
sentences.zh: 他唯一需要穿的囚服是一条条纹裤子。

sentences.en: His patients who weren't convicts he could collect fees from.
sentences.zh: 对于不是囚犯的病人，他还可以收取诊疗费。

sentences.en: For being in San Quentin, he had it pretty good.
sentences.zh: 既然身在圣昆廷监狱，他过得已经相当不错了。

sentences.en: But nonetheless,
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，

sentences.en: he just found it enormously oppressive and was quoted as saying that he would almost have preferred to have gone to the gallows than to just be locked up in a cell for 15 hours out of 24.
sentences.zh: 他还是觉得这极其令人压抑，据称他曾说过，他宁愿去走绞刑架，也不愿一天24小时里有15小时被锁在单人牢房里。

sentences.en: Chalfant had a female admirer on the outside fighting for his release by normal legal means.
sentences.zh: 查尔方特在外面有一位女崇拜者，正通过正常的法律途径为他的获释而斗争。

sentences.en: But it was alleged that she also tried to get him out of prison through less than legal means.
sentences.zh: 但据称她还试图通过不太合法的手段把他从监狱里救出来。

sentences.en: Someone slipped him some, you know, non-striped trousers, a railroad ticket, some money and some pistols, a bag of laundry,
sentences.zh: 有人塞给他，你知道的，一条非条纹的裤子、一张火车票、一些钱和几把手枪、一袋换洗衣物，

sentences.en: and he snuck out with a crowd of visitors taking the boat back to the city.
sentences.zh: 他混在一群坐船回城的游客中偷偷溜了出去。

sentences.en: And before they noticed he was gone, he was safely ensconced on a Utah-bound train.
sentences.zh: 在人们发现他失踪之前，他已经安稳地坐上了开往犹他州的火车。

sentences.en: The only reason he was caught, he had disguised himself with some whiskers, but he was eating a peach while they were crossing Nevada,
sentences.zh: 他被抓获的唯一原因是他用假胡子伪装了自己，但在穿内华达州的时候他正在吃一个桃子，

sentences.en: and the juice from the peach loosened the gum holding his whiskers enough that a rail detective spotted that this guy looked kind of suspicious.
sentences.zh: 桃子流出的汁液把固定假胡子的胶水弄松了，导致一个铁路侦探发现这家伙看起来有点可疑。

sentences.en: He was detained in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 他在内华达州被扣留了。

sentences.en: He never made it past Winnemucca.
sentences.zh: 他没能过得了韦尼穆卡。

sentences.en: Even though he got caught escaping, he was later pardoned and only spent six years in prison when he got out.
sentences.zh: 尽管越狱被抓，但他后来受到了特赦，出狱时只在监狱里度过了六年。

sentences.en: He returned to San Francisco and was a very successful dentist until he retired shortly before the earthquake.
sentences.zh: 他返回了旧金山，并成为了一名非常成功的牙医，直到地震前不久退休。

sentences.en: But it must have felt kind of weird making vulcanite dentures.
sentences.zh: 但制作硫化橡胶假牙感觉一定有点怪怪的。

sentences.en: In doing my research, I found a directory of professional men of San Francisco from the 1890s.
sentences.zh: 在做研究时，我找到了一个19世纪90年代旧金山专业人士名录。

sentences.en: And there was a half page in there on him, and it talks about his education, his experience in serving the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 里面有半页关于他的介绍，谈到了他的教育背景以及参加美国内战的经历。

sentences.en: But it makes absolutely no mention of Rubber Dentures, Josiah Bacon, or the Vulcanite Company.
sentences.zh: 但里面完全没有提及橡胶假牙、约西亚·培根或硫化橡胶公司。

sentences.en: But this extreme case of anti-patent troll vigilantism, or cold-blooded murder, however you want to view it, did have an effect.
sentences.zh: 但这种反专利流氓的极端治安维持行为——或者说冷血谋杀，无论你怎么看——确实产生了影响。

sentences.en: The Goodyear Vulcanite Company stopped enforcing their patent.
sentences.zh: 固特异硫化橡胶公司停止了专利维权。

sentences.en: Apparently, none of their employees was really willing to take a chance of being shot by a dentiSt.
sentences.zh: 显然，他们的员工没有一个真愿冒着被牙医枪杀的风险。

sentences.en: And there's also the implication that sort of this whole denture patent was kind of a Josiah Bacon's personal project, more than it was major policy of the company's.
sentences.zh: 这也暗示了这种整个假牙专利在某种程度上更多是约西亚·培根的个人项目，而不是公司的主要政策。

sentences.en: And the patent lapsed.
sentences.zh: 于是该专利失效了。

sentences.en: Most of the world forgot about Samuel Chalfant.
sentences.zh: 世界上大多数人都遗忘了塞缪尔·查尔方特。

sentences.en: But the late 19th century dental profession learned from their bitter experience in what they considered the Vulcanite Rubber patent reign of terror.
sentences.zh: 但19世纪末的牙医行业从他们所经历的被称为“硫化橡胶专利恐怖统治”的痛苦经历中吸取了教训。

sentences.en: They collectively positioned themselves so that they could no longer be milked by any profiteering patent holders.
sentences.zh: 他们集体调整了立场，不再让任何牟取暴利的专利持有者榨取财富。

sentences.en: Many years later, a similar scheme was put into motion to try to collect royalties for gold crowns.
sentences.zh: 多年以后，类似的阴谋再次上演，试图为黄金牙冠收取专利费。

sentences.en: And the Dental Association killed it easily, without firing a single shot.
sentences.zh: 而牙医协会轻而易举地粉碎了它，甚至没有开出一枪。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由我罗曼·马尔斯制作。

sentences.en: It was based off a story by John Marr from his fanzine, Murder Can Be Fun.
sentences.zh: 它改编自约翰·马尔在他的地下刊物《谋杀可以很有趣》中的一个故事。

sentences.en: The great, great, life-changing fanzine, Murder Can Be Fun.
sentences.zh: 那本伟大、绝妙、能改变人生的地下刊物《谋杀可以很有趣》。

sentences.en: It's not a website.
sentences.zh: 它不是一个网站。

sentences.en: It's on paper.
sentences.zh: 它是印在纸上的。

sentences.en: Ask your parents.
sentences.zh: 去问问你们的父母吧。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Plastics Historian Julie Robinson.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢塑料历史学家朱莉·罗宾逊。

sentences.en: Yes, there is such thing as a Plastics Historian.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实有塑料历史学家这种职业。

sentences.en: And her name is Julie Robinson.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫朱莉·罗宾逊。

sentences.en: This program is made possible with support from Lunar, making a difference with creativity.
sentences.zh: 本节目由 Lunar 赞助播出，他们用创意创造不同。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW 91.7, local public radio in San Francisco, the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco, and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 这是旧金山本地公共广播电台 KALW 91.7、旧金山美国建筑师学会以及建筑与设计中心的一个项目。

sentences.en: This program is distributed by PRX, the public radio exchange, making public radio more public.
sentences.zh: 本节目由公共广播交流中心 PRX 分发，让公共广播更加公共化。

sentences.en: Find out more at prx.org.
sentences.zh: 请登录 prx.org 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: This week and every week, I am helped by superstar intern Sam Greenspan.
sentences.zh: 本周以及每一周，我都得到了超级实习生萨姆·格林斯潘的帮助。

sentences.en: If you see him in the hallway, pat him on the back, buy him a cup of coffee.
sentences.zh: 如果你在走廊里看到他，拍拍他的背，请他喝杯咖啡。

sentences.en: I know you're listening in PR.
sentences.zh: 我知道你在听，PR（Public Radio）。

sentences.en: Be nice to him now, because pretty soon, I think he's going to be our boss.
sentences.zh: 现在对好他一点，因为很快，我觉得他就要成为我们的老板了。

sentences.en: You can find the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到这个节目。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我在推特上的账号是 Roman Mars。

sentences.en: Or you can just catch up with us on the website, 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以直接通过我们的网站 99percentinvisible.org 与我们互动。
